<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="סיון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918734_theRebbe_176" batchId="meluket-_D7_A1_D7_99_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918734_theRebbe_176__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through toil in the details of the Oral Torah, one reaches a level beyond the general principle, drawing from the essence of the Torah rooted in the self-concealment of Ein Sof, leading to the discovery of new insights and ultimately to the revelation of Moshiach's Torah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Moreover,</t>
    <t s="1">through study and toil in the particulars of the Oral Torah,</t>
    <t s="2">one reaches a level even beyond the general principle.</t>
    <t s="3">For this is what they said: "Whatever a veteran student will innovate in the future"</t>
    <t s="4">(specifically "to innovate"</t>
    <t s="5">),</t>
    <t s="6">for through toil in Torah, one draws from the aspect of Torah as it is rooted in the self-concealment of the Essence of Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="7">which is above the aspect of Torah as it comes in a manner of extension and revelation.</t>
    <t s="8">And this is "I toiled and I found,"</t>
    <t s="9">for the concept of "finding"</t>
    <t s="10">("I found")</t>
    <t s="11">is that one finds a new thing that initially could not be imagined,</t>
    <t s="12">like a found object that comes</t>
    <t s="13">by way of absentmindedness.</t>
    <t s="14">And this is "I toiled and I found,"</t>
    <t s="15">that through toil in Torah one finds and reveals new matters,</t>
    <t s="16">and even to the extent that through toil in Torah</t>
    <t s="17">[and particularly in the inner dimension of Torah, which is like the Torah of Moshiach]</t>
    <t s="18">now,</t>
    <t s="19">we will merit the revelation of the Torah of Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="20">which comes</t>
    <t s="21">by way of absentmindedness,</t>
    <t s="22">"I have found Dovid My servant"</t>
    <t s="23">(specifically "I have found"),</t>
    <t s="24">for then there will be the revelation of the Essence of the Ein Sof without any garment,</t>
    <t s="25">(and even the revelation at the time of the Giving of the Torah was only like the revelation of the future),</t>
    <t s="26">with the coming of Moshiach our righteous one,</t>
    <t s="27">speedily, truly.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
